meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导你把第一个智能体接入聊天频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你刚部署好智能体服务，需要把它连上聊天频道
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and trigger a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up the agent service and need to connect it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会引导你一步步在指定聊天频道里创建第一个 NanoClaw 智能体:先确认服务在运行、频道已接入,再问你频道上的用户 ID 和显示名,然后运行脚本把智能体接到私信,最后让它给你发一条欢迎私信确认通路正常。
howto.when: 在频道凭据已配置好、服务正在运行时触发;典型场景是你想为某个聊天频道创建第一个 NanoClaw 智能体并验证私信通路。

say.text: 帮我在 Discord 创建第一个 NanoClaw 智能体
say.note: Claude 会开始引导你选频道并填写身份信息。

say.text: 我要给 Telegram 初始化智能体,并让它发欢迎私信
say.note: 会走配对码流程或直接收集你的 ID。

say.text: 为 Slack 搭第一个智能体,用 claude 作为运行模型
say.note: Claude 会询问你的用户 ID 并运行初始化脚本。

howto.what_en: Claude steps you through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a chat channel: verifies service and channel, asks for your user ID and display name, runs an init script, and has the agent send you a welcome DM to confirm delivery.
howto.when_en: Triggers after channel credentials are configured and the service is running, typically when you want to create the first NanoClaw agent for a chat channel and verify DM delivery.

say_en.text: Help me create the first NanoClaw agent on Discord.
say_en.note: Claude starts guiding you through channel and identity setup.

say_en.text: Initialize an agent on Telegram and have it send a welcome DM.
say_en.note: May use the pair-code flow or collect your ID directly.

say_en.text: Set up the first agent for Slack, running on claude.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for your user ID and run the init script.
